subject: Architecture demo & throughput characterization — scheduling and prep
messages:
From: Erin Patel <erin@nim-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Architecture demo + throughput characterization request

Hi Laura,

Thanks again for the quick intro last week. Nimbus is ready to move from feasibility to a hands-on run: we'd like a technical demo + architecture deep-dive that focuses on throughput/latency characterization so we can map expectations for our production traffic. High level: we want to validate token throughput targets under our traffic shape and exercise your caching and fallback behavior during burst windows.

Can your team run a 60–90 minute session next week that includes:
- Brief architecture walkthrough (15–20m)
- Targeted load run(s) against a staging endpoint (30–40m)
- Post-run analysis & next steps (15–30m)

Proposed windows (PDT): Mon Jun 7 10–12, Tue Jun 8 13–15, Wed Jun 9 09–11. We prefer Tue afternoon but can be flexible. Also: our initial throughput target is ~120k tokens/min sustained with 2x short spikes; average request lengths are 350 tokens with a 95th percentile of 900. We can provide sample traces and an S3 bucket of representative prompts.

Attached: nim-benchmarks-request.xlsx (high-level SLAs/traffic profile).

Who should we expect from Redwood? Would like an SRE/ops lead + an architect who can go into kernel/serving details.

Thanks,
Erin
Erin Patel
Head of EngOps, Nimbus Analytics
ops@nim-analytics.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Erin Patel <erin@nim-analytics.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 11:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Architecture demo + throughput characterization request

Hi Erin — great to hear Nimbus is ready to validate. We can definitely run the session and will design the run to hit the sustained/burst profile you described.

Availability: Tue Jun 8 13:00–14:30 PDT works best for our ops + architecture pairing (Karthik will lead the runner, Jordan will do the architecture walkthrough). If that slot works, we can reserve 90 minutes to leave time for analysis.

Pre-demo asks to make the run productive: 
- Provide a small sample set (S3 link or csv) with 1k representative prompts and a short summary of traffic distribution (your spreadsheet is helpful).
- Confirm whether you want us to use Redwood-hosted staging endpoint or a customer-dedicated instance (affects token accounting and isolation).
- Any compliance/NDAs required before we run load? We have a standard non-prod engagement NDA if you prefer.

We will: 
- Share a short runbook before the session (couple pages) describing the run-of-show and how we will measure tokens/sec, p50/p95 latency, and cache hit rates.
- Provide pre-warm steps and an SLI checklist so we can compare after the run.

Attaching a draft of our runbook: redwood-runbook-draft.md.

If Tuesday 13:00 PDT is good, I'll send a calendar invite and include a Zoom link + a small recording consent note for post-run analysis.

Cheers,
Laura Bennett
Senior Solutions Manager, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Erin Patel <erin@nim-analytics.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 6 Jun 2027 15:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Architecture demo + throughput characterization request

Looping in a quick run-of-show we can use — feel free to edit: 

1) 13:00–13:15 — Intros & goals (Laura + Erin)
2) 13:15–13:35 — Architecture deep-dive (Jordan): serving runtime, cache, routing policy, quantization notes
3) 13:35–14:10 — Load run(s) (Karthik): baseline run (10m), target-sustained run (25m), spike test (5–10m)
4) 14:10–14:25 — Quick analysis (Karthik + Marissa)
5) 14:25–14:30 — Next steps & owners (Laura)

Operational notes: 
- We'll capture token/sec, p50/p95, GPU utilization, cache hit rate, and any fallback events.
- Please upload one sample trace by EOD Mon Jun 7 to the S3 path in the spreadsheet and paste the link in the HubSpot record.

Attaching our internal loadtest playbook (loadtest-playbook.pdf) — it has the commands we run and the metric mapping we use so Nimbus can validate offline if needed.

If the confirmed slot is Tue 13:00 PDT, I'll add the invite and include a short pre-call checklist 24h before.

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Sr. Performance Engineer, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com

From: Erin Patel <erin@nim-analytics.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan_blake@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 16:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Architecture demo + throughput characterization request

Thanks all — Tue Jun 8 13:00 PDT confirmed. Appreciate the run-of-show, that looks perfect. A couple of clarifications ahead of time: 
- Sustained target: 120k tokens/min (2k tokens/sec) with 2x spikes up to 240k tokens/min for up to 3 minutes.
- Typical prompt length: median 350 tokens; 95th ~900 tokens.
- We'll provide S3 link with 1k sample prompts + a small set of replay traces (will upload by EOD Mon). Link will be added to HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890.
- No additional NDA required for non-prod load, but we'll sign your standard engagement NDA if that simplifies the notes.

Attachments: nim-sample-traces.tar.gz (small archive of 50 traces).

See you Tue 13:00 PDT — we'll join from the Nimbus Ops room (Erin, Priya, and a backend lead).

Best,
Erin
